class.name: OcgAspectSkydomebackground
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of a window skydome background.
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of a window skydome background.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a window skydome background. By default skydome is initialized with sun at its zenith (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), average clody (0.2), zero time parameter, zero fogginess, 512x512 texture size.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a window skydome background with given parameters.

method.name: SunDirection
method.description: Get sun direction. By default this value is (0, 1, 0) Sun direction with negative Y component represents moon with (-X, -Y, -Z) direction.

method.name: Cloudiness
method.description: Get cloud intensity. By default this value is 0.2 0.0 means no clouds at all and 1.0 - high clody.

method.name: TimeParameter
method.description: Get time of cloud simulation. By default this value is 0.0 This value might be tweaked to slightly change appearance of clouds.

method.name: Fogginess
method.description: Get fog intensity. By default this value is 0.0 0.0 means no fog and 1.0 - high fogginess

method.name: Size
method.description: Get size of cubemap. By default this value is 512

method.name: SetSunDirection
method.description: Set sun direction. By default this value is (0, 1, 0) Sun direction with negative Y component represents moon with (-X, -Y, -Z) direction.

method.name: SetCloudiness
method.description: Set cloud intensity. By default this value is 0.2 0.0 means no clouds at all and 1.0 - high clody.

method.name: SetTimeParameter
method.description: Set time of cloud simulation. By default this value is 0.0 This value might be tweaked to slightly change appearance of clouds.

method.name: SetFogginess
method.description: Set fog intensity. By default this value is 0.0 0.0 means no fog and 1.0 - high fogginess

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Set size of cubemap. By default this value is 512

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
